title: A linear bound for Fujita's freeness conjecture
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective variety of dimension $n$, and let $L$ be an ample Cartier divisor. We prove that $K_X+mL$ is globally generated for every integer $m\geq\lceil C_0n\rceil$, where $C_0=1.77629\ldots$ is an explicit constant. In particular, $K_X+2nL$ is globally generated. We also prove that if $Z$ is a normal projective variety of dimension $n$ with $K_Z$ Cartier, nef and big, then $|mK_Z|$ defines a birational map for every integer $m\geq1+\lceil C_0n+3\sqrt{2\mathrm{e}n}\rceil$.
